title: Open Document Manager Instructions in Document Manager
description: Answer: How do I open document manager instructions? This is the canonical Document Manager workflow for open-document-manager-instructions.
prerequisites: You are signed in as general and can access Document Manager.
Route /files is reachable and module data is loaded without blocking errors.
Required records and permissions for open-document-manager-instructions are available before execution.
steps: Navigate to /files and open Document Manager.
Verify active workspace/company context before running open document manager instructions.
Open the exact workflow action labeled for open document manager instructions.
Enter required fields for open document manager instructions (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute open document manager instructions with explicit confirmation in the UI.
Validate result rows/totals/artifacts on the same page before navigating away.
If output is generated (report, export, invoice, or link), verify it is accessible and associated with the same context.
Record resulting reference IDs or filenames for traceability and follow-up.
validations: The open-document-manager-instructions action completes without permission or validation errors.
Resulting state is visible immediately in Document Manager lists, metrics, or related output panels.
Output artifacts remain linked to the same entity/date context used during execution.
commonErrors: No data returned because filter/date/entity scope is missing or inconsistent.
Action appears successful but output record is not persisted or linked.
recovery: Reopen /files, reapply field values, and rerun open-document-manager-instructions with a narrowed scope.
Refresh session and confirm role permissions for general before retry.
Cross-check logs/output panes and relink missing artifacts to the correct context.

faq.question: How do I open document manager instructions?
faq.answer: Open Document Manager at /files, run open document manager instructions with required selections, and validate table/list + output artifacts before closing.

faq.question: How do I troubleshoot open document manager instructions if results are missing?
faq.answer: Recheck filters, dates, selected entities, and permissions; rerun and confirm row counts/totals update in place.
